operational_kpis.name: FDA De Novo Regulatory Submission Timeline
operational_kpis.reported_actual_q0: On Track for Late Q4 2026 Submission

tooltip_definitions.Revita Procedural Duodenal Mucosal Resur: Endoscopic catheter-based procedural therapy designed to remodel the duodenal lining and reset metabolic pathways in patients with type 2 diabetes and obesity.
tooltip_definitions.REMAIN-1 Pivotal Cohort Co-Primary Endpo: Randomized, sham-controlled clinical trial testing whether Revita maintains weight loss after GLP-1 discontinuation; met six-month endpoint with high statistical significance (80% retention vs 67% sham, p=0.0023).
tooltip_definitions.FDA De Novo Regulatory Pathway: Targeted medical device regulatory classification for novel low-to-moderate risk medical devices with no legally marketed predicate, on schedule for submission in late Q4 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Strategic Restructuring & 45% Headcount: Decisive corporate reorganization eliminating ~45% of workforce and halting internal Rejuva AAV-delivered GLP-1 gene therapy development to concentrate all capital on Revita commercialization.
tooltip_definitions.Cash Runway into Q2 2027: Total liquidity of $35.77M (cash, equivalents, and restricted cash) providing operational funding through planned late Q4 2026 FDA submission and Q1 2027 12-month REMAIN-1 readouts.
tooltip_definitions.Reverse Stock Split (1-for-12): Corporate restructuring effected October 2, 2026 consolidating common stock at a 1-for-12 ratio to satisfy Nasdaq minimum $1.00 bid price compliance requirements.
tooltip_definitions.Clinical-Stage Biotechnology Modality: Pre-commercial metabolic medical device and genetic therapies company with zero commercial product sales across all five historical quarters.
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Operating Loss: Quarterly operating loss of -$18.65M in Q3 2026, narrowing from -$22.69M in Q3 2025 (-17.8% YoY) as R&D expenditures curtailed.
tooltip_definitions.Research and Development: Laboratory, clinical investigator, and trial site expenditures totaling $12.45M in Q3 2026 (-28.7% YoY vs $17.46M in Q3 2025).
tooltip_definitions.Selling, General and Administrative: Corporate, compliance, and clinical legal costs totaling $6.20M in Q3 2026 (+18.3% YoY vs $5.24M in Q3 2025).
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Outflow: Net cash used in operating activities of -$15.71M in Q3 2026 (-$54.09M for 9M 2026), improving from -$22.71M in Q3 2025 and -$15.90M in Q2 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditure: Purchases of property, plant, and laboratory equipment totaling $0.00M in Q3 2026, reflecting asset-light trial site operations.
tooltip_definitions.Stock-Based Compensation: Non-cash equity grant amortization totaling $2.39M in Q3 2026 ($7.41M for 9M 2026).
tooltip_definitions.True Economic Free Cash Burn: Comprehensive cash burn of -$18.10M in Q3 2026, combining OCF (-$15.71M), CapEx ($0.00M), and SBC ($2.39M).
tooltip_definitions.Warrant and Notes Fair Value Adjustment: Non-cash derivative mark-to-market credit of $4.50M in Q3 2026 reflecting fluctuations in warrant and promissory debt obligations.
tooltip_definitions.REVEAL-1 Real-World Study: Open-label clinical evaluation showing real-world durability of duodenal ablation with sustained metabolic improvements post-GLP-1 therapy.
tooltip_definitions.Rejuva Gene Therapy Discontinuation: Decision to halt internal investment in AAV-delivered GLP-1 gene therapy programs to eliminate high-risk viral vector pre-clinical expenses and conserve $20M+ in cash.
tooltip_definitions.12-Month REMAIN-1 Pivotal Readout: Anticipated topline 12-month clinical efficacy and durability data expected in the first quarter of 2027.
tooltip_definitions.Nasdaq Minimum Bid Compliance: Regulatory listing status addressed via 1-for-12 reverse split and clinical data catalysts to restore market capitalization above $25M.
tooltip_definitions.Pre-Commercial Zero Revenue Baseline: Expected baseline of $0.00M revenue across historical and near-term forward quarters until FDA approval and procedural commercialization.
